claim: community-state selection transition decomposes into fixed/frontier, adaptive/continuation, and control-cost channels
identity: Delta s = lambda * Delta C_F - lambda * Delta C_A - Delta kappa

shared_properties: same multiset of complete per-resource abstract role profiles

interpretation: The registered collision isolates a state transition whose change in structural selection is entirely fixed/productive-frontier-side; adaptive continuation complexity and weaker marginal resource-role summaries remain unchanged.
scope: Conditional on the minimal cost-to-log-fitness mapping s(X)=lambda[C_F(X)-C_A(X)]-kappa(X); not an empirical claim that natural community changes realize these finite tasks.
